name: Band Serratus Punch
steps: Anchor a resistance band behind you at chest height, face away in a staggered stance, and hold one end straight ahead at shoulder height.
Keep your working elbow completely locked straight and brace your core so your torso stays still.
Slide your shoulder blade forward around your rib cage so your straight arm reaches farther ahead.
Glide your shoulder blade slowly back to neutral without letting the band yank your shoulder back, then switch sides.
tips: Keep your elbow straight and shoulders relaxed down so all movement comes from your shoulder blade gliding around your ribs.
Resist twisting your chest forward as you reach out against the band.
